fact: IRRI with sarmap and Kenya's National Irrigation Authority piloted the RIICE remote-sensing rice monitoring platform, monitoring rice area and yield over two main seasons and one off season at Mwea in 2023-24 and extending to Western Kenya irrigation schemes in 2024.
title: Remote sensing based Information and Insurance for Crops in emerging economies (RIICE) in Kenya (2023 & 2024)
publisher: CGIAR Research Initiative on Digital Innovation (IRRI)
